message_body.subject: Quick question on autonomous agent retry storms & token-velocity limits
message_body.body:
Hi Team,

Noticed the common challenge in production autonomous systems where agents attempting self-healing retries enter runaway loops, accumulating context bloat and sudden API token surges.

We built a 15-Point Black-Box Multi-Agent Safety Audit (€99, 24h SLA) that identifies:
- Token-velocity runaway vectors & missing circuit breaker thresholds
- Context bloat and stale lock collision states
- Unbounded retry loops in long-running tool chains

Key feature: Zero-Access Security. You share ZERO repository access, API keys, or internal prompt contents—we analyze only sanitized error schemas or exit code traces. Includes 3 concrete drop-in Python circuit-breaker and generation-fencing code recipes.

Would you be open to a 24-hour audit of one agent pipeline for €99 fixed? If so, reply 'AUDIT' and we'll send the 1-page intake checklist.

Best regards,
2026-Courier Commercial Engineering
